statusEn: As of 21 September, one material event has been verified for this issue. Daily collection discovers candidates, but publication requires date, source and factual verification. A policy statement is not a budget, project or procurement award.
summary: 通信部长在9月20日 Digital Nepal Conclave 提出韧性数字化的五项优先方向：信息可信、包容连接、政府互操作、以公民为中心的服务，以及负责任的AI与数据治理。
本次讲话强化了灾害响应、数据交换和公共服务连续性的政策信号，但未公布新增预算、招标、时间表或设备厂家。
后续应跟踪 MoCIT、ITDGO、NTA 及主管部门发布的实施计划、预算和采购文件，再判断具体客户与商机。
summaryEn: At the 20 September Digital Nepal Conclave, the communications minister set out five priorities for resilient digital transformation: trusted information, inclusive connectivity, government interoperability, citizen-centred services, and responsible AI and data governance.
The speech strengthens the policy signal around disaster response, data exchange and continuity of public services, but announces no new budget, tender, timetable or equipment vendor.
Follow MoCIT, ITDGO, NTA and implementing agencies for delivery plans, budgets and procurement documents before treating the agenda as a defined customer opportunity.

items.title: 通信部长提出“韧性数字化”五项优先方向，灾害期间服务连续性进入政策核心
items.titleEn: Communications minister sets five priorities for resilient digital transformation
items.text: 事实：尼泊尔公共广播 Radio Nepal、Digital Nepal Conclave 官方议程及 Technology Khabar 显示，通信部长 Dr Bikram Timilsina 于9月20日在拉利特普尔举行的 Digital Nepal Conclave 2026 上表示，数字化不仅是技术扩展和政务现代化，还应在灾害与危机中维持信息、通信及公共服务。他提出五项优先方向：信息可信与公众信任、可靠且包容的连接、政府机构互操作、以公民为中心的数字服务，以及负责任的人工智能与数据治理。此次讲话是政策方向，不是已批准的预算、建设项目、招标或设备授标。
items.textEn: Radio Nepal, the official Digital Nepal Conclave programme and Technology Khabar report that Communications Minister Dr Bikram Timilsina told the 20 September event in Lalitpur that digital transformation must extend beyond technology expansion and service modernisation to maintain information, communications and public services during disasters and crises. He identified five priorities: information integrity and public trust, reliable and inclusive connectivity, interoperability among government bodies, citizen-centred digital services, and responsible AI and data governance. The speech sets policy direction; it is not an approved budget, deployment project, tender or equipment award.
items.opportunity: 客户影响：MoCIT、ITDGO、NTA 及承担应急、数据交换和公共服务的平台单位可能面临更高的业务连续性、互操作、安全和灾备要求，但讲话没有确认具体实施主体或采购范围。竞争研判：会议信息列出多家支持方和展示企业，不能据此认定任何公司已获项目或形成设备选型。下一步：逐项跟踪部委实施方案、年度预算、NTA/PPMO公告、政府架构与数据治理标准，并向主管机构核实灾害通信和跨部门数据交换的责任边界。证据缺口：预算、里程碑、技术架构、采购方式、供应商和合同均未披露。
items.opportunityEn: Customer impact: MoCIT, ITDGO, NTA and agencies responsible for emergency response, data exchange and public-service platforms may face stronger continuity, interoperability, security and recovery requirements, but the speech does not identify an implementation owner or procurement scope. Competition: the event lists supporters and exhibitors; participation does not establish a project award or equipment selection. Next action: track ministry implementation plans, annual budgets, NTA/PPMO notices, government architecture and data-governance standards, and confirm ownership of emergency communications and inter-agency data exchange with the relevant authorities. Gaps: no budget, milestones, architecture, procurement method, supplier or contract was disclosed.
